description: Source code for a web scraper class 'Reishunger' that extracts ingredients, equipment, and instructions from a recipe webpage on reishunger.de.

classes.name: Reishunger
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe details from reishunger.de

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'reishunger.de' for the scraper

methods.name: _filter_ingredients
methods.description: Parses the ingredients and equipment sections from the recipe page HTML

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns the list of ingredients extracted from the page

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Returns the list of equipment items extracted from the page

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and returns the cooking instructions from the recipe page
